subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "Good morning, Rupa," said Sohel, "How much preparation have you taken for the upcoming SSC exam?" "A great preparation," replied she. "I hope, I shall get 90+ marks in every subject." "How confident you are!" said Sohel.
guide_solution: Sohel wished Rupa good morning and asked her how much preparation she had taken for the upcoming SSC exam. Rupa replied that she had taken a great preparation. She hoped to get 90+ marks in every subject. Sohel exclaimed with wonder that she was so confident.
